tasks.subject: Task 1: Server: SENDER_KEY rules, PREKEY_CONSUMED stall fix, group fan-out tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Nodes accept well-formed group envelopes and fan them out; an unknown node's PREKEY_CONSUMED no longer stalls a peer session.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server && make check`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`kind = SENDER_KEY` ⇒ `shared_content` non-empty and every recipient's `content` empty; `SIGNAL`/`PREKEY_SIGNAL` ⇒ `shared_content` empty and every recipient has content", "`ApplyReplicated`: a `PREKEY_CONSUMED` whose author is not in the current manifest is **skipped** (returns `false, nil`, logged at debug) instead of `ErrRetryLater`.", "Gateway e2e: one SENDER_KEY envelope to 4 recipients → each logged-in recipient receives it; after 3 ACKs the record still exists; after the 4th it's deleted", "meshsim scenario 9: group envelope sent via A to members logged in on A, B, C → all receive it; ACKs from all → record gone everywhere", "`make check` green"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Message context menu above the pressed message (bug fix)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Long-press opens the menu directly above the bubble, aligned with the bubble's side; it never jumps to the left edge.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`./gradlew :core:ui:test :feature:conversation:testDebugUnitTest`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["The menu anchors to the bubble's own bounds (the `Surface`), not the row", "Position: bottom edge of the menu = bubble top − 8 dp; horizontally aligned to the bubble's **end** for outgoing and **start** for incoming", "Menu items: same as today (Повторить if failed, Копировать, Удалить у меня) plus **Сведения** for outgoing group messages (Task 10).", "Pure position function unit-tested: outgoing near the bottom → above, right-aligned; incoming → left-aligned; bubble at the top → below; tall bubble → top; narrow window clamps x", "Compose test: long-press on a bubble shows the menu items; Back dismisses"]}
```

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`python3 scripts/export-assets.py --check && ./gradlew :core:ui:test assembleDebug`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Masters copied byte-identical (script `--check` verifies the SHA-256s against both manifests and fails on a mismatch); masters never modified", "`export-assets.py` (deterministic, idempotent):", "Adaptive icon: `<background android:drawable=\"@color/ic_launcher_background\"/>` (`#DCF1E3`), `<foreground android:drawable=\"@mipmap/ic_launcher_foreground\"/>`,", "`ic_launcher_monochrome.xml` = vector from `otter_m3_monochrome_head.svg`: `width/height 108dp`, `viewportWidth/Height 1024`, a `<group>` with", "App theme: `Theme.Otter` (light parent `android:Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar`, window background `#FAF7F2`; night parent `android:Theme.Material.NoActionBar`,", "`OtterIllustration(@DrawableRes id, maxSize: Dp, modifier)` = `Image(painterResource, contentDescription = null, contentScale = Fit)`, never tinted;", "Placements: Welcome screen (≤ 200 dp, above the title); chat list **truly empty after the first directory sync** → `otter_no_chats` (≤ 180 dp) +", "`OtterAvatar(name, seed: ByteArray, size, family: Boolean = false)`: family ⇒ `otter_family_avatar` fitted inside the circle (`ContentScale.Fit`, no crop) on", "`AvatarPalette`: 8 (background, text) pairs for light and 8 for dark, all ≥ 4.5:1 contrast (unit test computes the WCAG ratio, like `ContrastTest`)", "All existing avatar call sites pass the id seed; launcher checked on the emulator in circle and squircle shapes (Pixel launcher + Settings → themed icons on)", "Release APK size noted (should grow by < 1 MB)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: `core:data` — group state management
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create and change groups locally, distribute signed updates, apply incoming ones with the rules, record system events, trigger rotation.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`./gradlew :core:data:testDebugUnitTest --tests '*Group*'`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`GroupRepository`: `create(name, family, members)`, `addMembers`, `removeMember`, `rename`, `setAdmin(user, admin)`, `leave()`. Each builds the next state", "`GroupApplier.apply(signed, from)`: verify the signature with the signer's account key (unknown signer → directory sync once → still unknown → park);", "System events (stored as `messages` rows, kind `SYSTEM_GROUP`, `system_data` = proto `GroupEvent{type, actor, targets, name}`): created, added, removed, left,", "**Rotation trigger:** when an accepted state removes anyone (removed or left), delete `my_distribution` for that group (a new distId is created on the next send,", "Removed (or left) self: `i_am_member = false`, conversation stays readable, the composer is disabled (Task 10)", "Adding members: their 1:1 sessions are established lazily by the outbox like any 1:1 message (prekeys fetched on demand)"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: `core:data` — group messaging and receipts
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Send and receive group messages; per-recipient delivery state.

```json:metadata
{"verifyCommand": "`./gradlew :core:data:testDebugUnitTest`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`MessageRepository.sendText(conversationId, text)` for a group conversation: one transaction inserts the message (PENDING), `message_recipients` rows", "Outbox, group item, first processing: (1) ensure `my_distribution` exists (new random UUID if missing); (2) for every current member lacking a row in", "If membership shrank between enqueue and send, recipients are still the frozen set minus removed members (never send to a removed member)", "Receive `SENDER_KEY`: decrypt via `GroupSessions.decrypt(senderAddress, shared_content)`. `NoSessionException` or unknown group → store in `pending_group_envelopes`", "After decrypt: `content.data.group.group_id` must be a group where the sender ∈ members and I ∈ members (my state); otherwise drop (logged). Insert the message", "Receive `SenderKeyDistribution` (1:1): `GroupSessions.process(sender, message)`, then retry pending envelopes", "Receipts: a receipt for a message I sent to a group updates that message's `message_recipients` row for the receipt's author **only if** that author is in the", "`markConversationRead(groupConversation)` sends READ receipts grouped **per sender** (one receipt message per sender)", "24 h resend works for group items (same record); outbox rows are deleted when the aggregate reaches DELIVERED", "Integration tests (Robolectric, real libsignal, `FakeNode` extended to fan out SENDER_KEY envelopes), 5 clients A–E:"]}
```
